import subprocess

# Read current file
result = subprocess.run(['cat', 'markdown/extensions/toc.py'], capture_output=True, text=True)
content = result.stdout

# The issue: html.unescape on raw HTML with tags causes slugify to include tag names
# Fix: for ID generation, strip tags first, then unescape, then slugify
# This way slugify operates on decoded Unicode text without tag artifacts

old_code = '''                # Do not override pre-existing ids
                if "id" not in el.attrib:
                    # Apply html.unescape only before slugify so slugify operates on decoded Unicode
                    innertext = html.unescape(inner_html)
                    el.attrib["id"] = unique(self.slugify(innertext, self.sep), used_ids)'''

new_code = '''                # Do not override pre-existing ids
                if "id" not in el.attrib:
                    # Strip tags, then unescape for slugify (unescape only before slugify)
                    stripped_for_slug = striptags(inner_html)
                    innertext = html.unescape(stripped_for_slug)
                    el.attrib["id"] = unique(self.slugify(innertext, self.sep), used_ids)'''

if old_code in content:
    content = content.replace(old_code, new_code)
    with open('markdown/extensions/toc.py', 'w') as f:
        f.write(content)
    print("Fixed ID generation")
else:
    print("Pattern not found!")
    # Show context around the area
    idx = content.find('Do not override pre-existing ids')
    if idx >= 0:
        print(repr(content[idx:idx+400]))
